assumptions.observable_vector: three complex carrier amplitudes = six real coordinates
assumptions.scope: symbolic physical projection-manifold gate; no runtime

phase_lock_constraint: arg Lambda_c - arg Lambda_in + arg Lambda_out = 0 mod pi for the minimal outer-dipole phase-locked model

rows.notes: This is the clean 10.4 positive gate: carrier ratios or deprojection recover the shared G(i Omega_k).
The combination-carrier phase is locked to the two orbital phases. The manifold has one constraint inside the six-real dimensional complex carrier vector.
rows.nuisance_class: finite shared, not arbitrary per carrier
rows.parameterization: Lambda_in=A_in e^{i phi_in}, Lambda_out=A_out e^{i phi_out}, Lambda_c=A_c e^{i(phi_in-phi_out)}

rows.notes: A product-like outer-dipole amplitude link is still finite and shared. It strengthens the case that the projection is not three independent complex amplitudes.
rows.parameterization: Lambda_c=H A_in A_out e^{i(phi_in-phi_out+sigma)} with calibrated H
rows.projection_manifold: finite shared real manifold with amplitude link
rows.real_parameter_count: 5 fitted real parameters when sigma floats; 4 if sigma is calibrated

rows.notes: This class can consume much of the three-carrier pressure. It needs either a projection prior, more carriers, or a stricter physical derivation.
rows.parameterization: Lambda_k=ell0+ell1 z_k or equivalent shared complex model
rows.real_parameter_count: 4 real parameters for degree-1 complex template

rows.notes: This rank fills the full carrier-amplitude space, so the projection can absorb the shared transfer relation pointwise.
rows.parameterization: Lambda_in, Lambda_out, Lambda_c are independent complex numbers

rows.notes: If the combination phase is allowed to float independently of the inner and outer phases, the physical phase-lock is lost and the gate reduces to arbitrary complex projection.
rows.parameterization: A_k e^{i phi_k} for k in {in,out,c}

rows.notes: Runtime work becomes scientifically justified only if the actual projection is closer to the finite phase-locked manifold than to independent complex carrier amplitudes.
rows.nuisance_class: finite shared if phase locks and geometry links are enforced
rows.parameterization: must be derived for the named timing model

runtime_worthiness_rule.conditional: projection rank or priors must be closed before runtime
runtime_worthiness_rule.not-runtime-motivated: projection spans independent complex carrier amplitudes and collapses the bridge
runtime_worthiness_rule.runtime-motivated: projection is calibrated or finite shared with phase/geometric links, so runtime can test a specific shared-tau target
